name: Goblin Berserker
sourceDescription: Goblin berserker kazhdyj hod nanosit 2 urona sosednim sushhestvam hozjaina.

name: Wall Of Fire
sourceDescription: Kogda stena ognja prizvana, ona nanosit 5 urona vsem sushhestvam protivnika.

name: Priest of Fire
sourceDescription: Zhrec ognja uvelichivaet na 1 prirost Sily Ognja hozjaina.

name: Fire Drake
sourceDescription: Ognennyj drakonchik atakuet na tom zhe hodu, chto i prizvan.

name: Orc Chieftain
sourceDescription: Ork predvoditel' uvelichivaet ataku sosednih sushhestv hozjaina na 2.

name: Flame Wave
sourceDescription: Nanosit 9 urona sushhestvam protivnika.

name: Minotaur Commander
sourceDescription: Komandir minotavrov uvelichivaet na 1 ataku vseh ostal'nyh sushhestv hozjaina(krome sten).

name: Bargul
sourceDescription: Kogda bargul prizvan, on nanosit 4 urona vsem ostal'nym sushhestvam.

name: Inferno
sourceDescription: Nanosit 18 urona vybrannomu sushhestvu i 10 urona vsem ostal'nym sushhestvam protivnika.

name: Fire Elemental
sourceDescription: Kogda ognennyj jelemental' prizvan, on nanosit 3 urona protivniku i ego sushhestvam. Uvelichivaet na 1 prirost Sily Ognja hozjaina.

name: Armageddon
sourceDescription: Nanosit (8+sila Ognja maga) urona protivniku i vsem sushhestvam v igre.

name: Dragon
sourceDescription: Drakon uvelichivaet na 50% ves' uron, nanesennyj zaklinanijami hozjaina (itogovyj uron budet okruglen vverh).

name: Meditation
sourceDescription: Uvelichivaet magu silu Ognja, Vozduha i Zemli na 1.

name: Sea Sprite
sourceDescription: Vodnyj duh nanosit 2 urona hozjainu kazhdyj hod.

name: Merfolk Apostate
sourceDescription: Kogda merfolk otstupnik prizvan, on uvelichivaet Silu Ognja hozjaina na 2.

name: Ice Golem
sourceDescription: Ledjanoj golem ne poluchaet urona ot zaklinanij i sposobnostej sushhestv.

name: Merfolk Elder
sourceDescription: Merfolk mudrec uvelichivaet prirost Sily Vozduha hozjaina na 1.

name: Ice Guard
sourceDescription: Ledjanoj strazh umen'shaet na 50% ves' uron, nanesennyj hozjainu. (itogovyj uron budet okruglen vverh).

name: Giant Turtle
sourceDescription: Ves' uron, nanesennyj po ogromnoj cherepahe, umen'shaetsja na 5.

name: Acidic Rain
sourceDescription: Nanosit 15 urona po vsem sushhestvam. Umen'shaet na 1 vse Sily sopernika.

name: Merfolk Overlord
sourceDescription: Merfolk predvoditel' pozvoljaet sushhestvam hozjaina, prizvannym v sosednie sloty, atakovat' v tom zhe hodu, v kotorom oni prizvany.

name: Water Elemental
sourceDescription: Kogda vodnyj jelemental' prizvan, on lechit hozjainu 10 zhizni. Uvelichivaet na 1 prirost Sily Vody hozjaina.

name: Mind Master
sourceDescription: Vlastelin magii uvelichivaet na 1 prirost vseh Sil hozjaina.

name: Astral Guard
sourceDescription: Astral'nyj strazh umen'shaet na 1prirost vseh Sil protivnika.

name: Faerie Apprentice
sourceDescription: Feja uchenik uvelichivaet na 1 uron vseh zaklinanij hozjaina.

name: Griffin
sourceDescription: Pri vhode v igru - nanosit 5 urona protivniku, esli Sila Vozduha hozjaina ne men'she 5.

name: Call to Thunder
sourceDescription: Nanosit 6 urona vybrannomu sushhestvu protivnika i samomu protivniku.

name: Faerie Sage
sourceDescription: Kogda fej starec prizvan, on lechit hozjainu kolichestvo zdorov'ja, ravnoe Sile Zemli hozjaina, no ne bolee 10 zdorov'ja.

name: Wall of Lightnings
sourceDescription: Stena molnij nanosit 4 urona protivniku kazhdyj hod.

name: Lightning bolt
sourceDescription: Nanosit (5+Sila Vozduha maga) urona protivniku.

name: Phoenix
sourceDescription: Kazhdyj raz, kogda feniks umiraet, esli Sila Ognja hozjaina 10 libo vyshe, to feniks vozrozhdaetsja.

name: Chain Lightning
sourceDescription: Nanosit 9 urona protivniku i vsem ego sushhestvam.

name: Lightning Cloud
sourceDescription: Pri atake grozovaja tucha nanosit uron srazu vsem sushhestvam protivnika i samomu protivniku.

name: Tornado
sourceDescription: Unichtozhaet vybrannoe sushhestvo protivnika.

name: Air Elemental
sourceDescription: Kogda vozdushnyj jelemental' prizvan, on nanosit 8 urona protivniku. Uvelichivaet prirost Sily Vozduha hozjaina na 1.

name: Titan
sourceDescription: Kogda titan prizvan, on nanosit 15 urona sushhestvu protivnika v slote naprotiv.

name: Elven Healer
sourceDescription: Jel'f celitel' lechit 3 zhizni hozjainu kazhdyj hod.

name: Nature's Ritual
sourceDescription: Prirodnyj ritual lechit 8 zhizni vybrannomu sushhestvu i magu, sygravshemu jeto zaklinanie.

name: Forest Sprite
sourceDescription: Pri atake lesnoj duh nanosit uron srazu vsem sushhestvam protivnika i samomu protivniku.

name: Rejuvenation
sourceDescription: Mag isceljaetsja na kolichestvo zdorov'ja, ravnoe ego udvoennoj Sile Zemli.

name: Elf Hermit
sourceDescription: Jel'f otshel'nik uvelichivaet prirost Sily Zemli hozjaina na 2.

name: Natural Fury
sourceDescription: Nanosit protivniku uron, ravnyj summarnoj atake dvuh sil'nejshih sushhestv igroka, sygravshego jeto zaklinanie.

name: Giant Spider
sourceDescription: Kogda ogromnyj pauk prizvan, on razmeshhaet v sosednie sloty lesnyh paukov (2/11).

name: Troll
sourceDescription: Troll' vospolnjaet sebe 4 edinicy zdorov'ja kazhdyj hod.

name: Stone Rain
sourceDescription: Nanosit 25 urona kazhdomu sushhestvu.

name: Earth Elemental
sourceDescription: Zemljanoj jelemental' uvelichivaet prirost Sily Zemli hozjaina na 1.

name: Master Healer
sourceDescription: Kazhdyj hod verhovnyj celitel' lechit 3 zhizni hozjainu i vsem ego sushhestvam.

name: Hydra
sourceDescription: Pri atake gidra nanosit uron srazu vsem sushhestvam protivnika i samomu protivniku. Vospolnjaet sebe 4 edinicy zdorov'ja kazhdyj hod.

name: Dark Ritual
sourceDescription: Nanosit 3 urona vsem sushhestvam protivnika. Lechit 3 zhizni sushhestvam maga, sygravshego jeto zaklinanie.

name: Cursed Fog
sourceDescription: Nanosit 12 urona vsem sushhestvam i 3 urona protivniku.

name: Banshee
sourceDescription: Pri vhode v igru nanosit uron sushhestvu v slote naprotiv, ravnyj polovine zhizni jetogo sushhestva. (uron okrugljaetsja vverh)

name: Emissary of Dorlak
sourceDescription: Jemissar Dorlaka mozhet byt' prizvan tol'ko poverh drugogo sushhestva, kotoroe prinositsja v zhertvu.

name: Blood Ritual
sourceDescription: Unichtozhaet vybrannoe sushhestvo hozjaina. Nanosit sushhestvam protivnika uron, ravnyj kolichestvu zhizni unichtozhennogo sushhestva (no ne bolee 32 urona).

name: Keeper of Death
sourceDescription: Kazhdyj raz, kogda sushhestvo protivnika umiraet, hranitel' smerti povyshaet Silu Smerti hozjaina na 1.

name: Drain Souls
sourceDescription: Unichtozhaet vseh sushhestv v igre. Mag, sygravshij jeto zaklinanie, poluchaet 2 zhizni za kazhdoe umershee sushhestvo. Posle primenenija zamenjaetsja na zaklinanie Jarost dush.

name: Master Lich
sourceDescription: Pri vhode v igru nanosit 8 urona sushhestvam protivnika. Kogda Verhovnyj lich nanosit uron protivniku, on povyshaet na 2 silu cmerti hozjaina.

name: Paladin
sourceDescription: Pri vhode v igru isceljaet 4 zhizni kazhdomu sushhestvu hozjaina.

name: Monk
sourceDescription: Kogda monah umiraet, on povyshaet Silu Svjatosti hozjaina na 2.

name: Holy Guard
sourceDescription: Svjatoj strazh umen'shaet na 2 ves' uron, nanesennyj po sushhestvam v sosednih slotah.

name: Divine Justice
sourceDescription: Isceljaet 12 urona vybrannomu sushhestvu, nanosit 12 urona vsem ostal'nym sushhestvam.

name: Divine Intervention
sourceDescription: Povyshaet na 2 Sily Ognja, Vody, Vozduha i Zemli magu, sygravshemu jeto zaklinanie. Isceljaet 10 zhizni jetomu magu.

name: Wrath of God
sourceDescription: Nanosit 12 urona sushhestvam protivnika i zatem povyshaet silu Svjatosti zaklinatelja na 1 za kazhdoe ucelevshee sushhestvo protivnika.

name: Angel
sourceDescription: Pri vhode v igru povyshaet Silu Svjatosti hozjaina na 3.

name: Archangel
sourceDescription: Pri vhode v igru polnost'ju isceljaet vseh sojuznyh sushhestv.

name: Overtime
sourceDescription: Povyshaet Silu Mehaniki maga na 1.

name: Dwarven Rifleman
sourceDescription: Kazhdyj raz, kogda protivnik prizyvaet sushhestvo, gnom-strelok nanosit 4 urona jetomu sushhestvu.

name: Dwarven Craftsman
sourceDescription: Gnom-kuznec povyshaet na 1 prirost Sily Mehaniki hozjaina.

name: Ornithopter
sourceDescription: Ornitopter nanosit 2 urona po vsem sushhestvam protivnika kazhdyj hod.

name: Steel Golem
sourceDescription: Stal'noj golem ne poluchaet urona ot zaklinanij i sposobnostej sushhestv. Vsjakij uron, nanesennyj stal'nomu golemu, umen'shaetsja na 1.

name: Cannon
sourceDescription: Kazhdyj hod pushka nanosit 8 urona sushhestvu protivnika s naibol'shej zhizn'ju.

name: Cannonade
sourceDescription: Nanosit 19 urona vsem sushhestvam protivnika.

name: Steam Tank
sourceDescription: Pri vhode v igru nanosit 12 urona vsem sushhestvam protivnika.

name: Madness
sourceDescription: Nanosit kazhdomu sushhestvu protivnika uron, ravnyj atake jetogo sushhestva.

name: Phantom Warrior
sourceDescription: Vsjakij uron, nanosimyj fantomnomu voinu, ne prevoshodit 1.

name: Hypnosys
sourceDescription: Dva sil'nejshih vrazheskih sushhestva atakujut protivnika.

name: Wall of Reflection
sourceDescription: Kazhdyj raz, kogda stena otrazhenij poluchaet uron, ona nanosit takoj zhe uron protivniku.

name: Spectral Assassin
sourceDescription: Kogda prizrachnyj ubijca prizvan, on nanosit 12 urona protivniku.

name: Spectral Mage
sourceDescription: Pri vhode v igru nanosit uron kazhdomu sushhestvu protivnika, ravnyj stoimosti jetogo sushhestva.

name: Oracle
sourceDescription: Kazhdyj hod orakul nanosit protivniku uron, ravnyj Sile Illjuzij hozjaina.

name: Hypnotyst
sourceDescription: Pri vhode v igru nanosit 5 urona protivniku i vsem ego sushhestvam. Povyshaet prirost Sily Illjuzij hozjaina na 1.

name: Goblin Shaman
sourceDescription: Goblin shaman povyshaet stoimost' vseh zaklinanij protivnika na 1.

name: Weakness
sourceDescription: Ponizhaet na 1 vse Sily protivnika. Nanosit 3 urona protivniku.

name: Damping Tower
sourceDescription: Sverkajushhaja bashnja povyshaet stoimost' vseh kart protivnika na 1.

name: Ancient Horror
sourceDescription: Drevnij uzhas prinuzhdaet sushhestv protivnika so stoimost'ju men'shej chem Sila Kontrolja hozjaina propuskat' svoju ataku.

name: Poisonous Cloud
sourceDescription: Ponizhaet na 1 Sily protivnika. Nanosit po kazhdomu sushhestvu protivnika uron ravnyj polovine zhizni jetogo sushhestva. (uron okrugljaetsja vverh)

name: Ancient Witch
sourceDescription: Ataka 4, zhizn' 18 Pri vhode v igru ponizhaet vse Sily protivnika na 2.

name: Mindstealer
sourceDescription: Kogda sushhestvo v slote naprotiv atakuet, ono nanosit uron ne pohititelju razuma, a sebe.

name: Ancient Giant
sourceDescription: Pri vhode v igru oglushaet protivnika, vynuzhdaja togo propustit' sledujushhij hod.

name: Insanian Peacekeeper
sourceDescription: Bezumnyj mirotvorec lechit hozjainu 1-6 zhizni kazhdyj hod.

name: Insanian Berserker
sourceDescription: Bezumnyj berserk nanosit protivniku 1-6 urona kazhdyj hod.

name: Doom Bolt
sourceDescription: Nanosit 25 urona sluchajnomu sushhestvu protivnika.

name: Chaotic wave
sourceDescription: Nanosit 2-12 urona sushhestvam protivnika. Isceljaet 2-12 urona svoim sushhestvam.

name: Insanian Shaman
sourceDescription: Kazhdyj hod bezumnyj shaman ponizhaet sluchajnuju Silu protivnika na 2.

name: Insanian Lord
sourceDescription: Kazhdyj hod bezumnyj lord povyshaet sluchajnuju Silu hozjaina na 2.

name: Insanian Catapult
sourceDescription: Kazhdyj hod katapul'ta nanosit 10 urona sluchajnomu sushhestvu protivnika.

name: Insanian King
sourceDescription: V konce kazhdogo hoda hozjaina bezumnyj korol' prizyvaet v sluchajnyj slot bezumnogo soldata (4/15).

name: Lemure
sourceDescription: Kogda lemur pogibaet, on zamenjaetsja 3/6 vozrodivshimsja lemurom.

name: Explosion
sourceDescription: Unichtozhaet vybrannoe sushhestvo hozjaina. Nanosit 28 urona sushhestvu v slote naprotiv.

name: Power Chains
sourceDescription: Nanosit 12 urona po vybrannomu ognennomu, vodnomu, vozdushnomu ili zemljanomu sushhestvu. Protivnik terjaet 3 many takogo tipa.

name: Ergodemon
sourceDescription: Kogda jergodemon pogibaet, vse Sily protivnika ponizhajutsja na 1.

name: Demon Quartermaster
sourceDescription: Povyshaet prirost demonicheskoj sily hozjaina na 1. Kogda demon ad'jutant pogibaet, on vozrazhdaetsja kak 6/20 raz#jarjonnyj ad'jutant.

name: HellFire
sourceDescription: Nanosit 13 urona vsem sushhestvam protivnika. Mag poluchaet odnu silu ognja za kazhdoe sushhestvo, pogibshee ot jetogo zaklinanija.

name: Three-headed demon
sourceDescription: Pri atake nanosit uron srazu vsem sushhestvam protivnika i samomu protivniku. Kogda trjohgolovyj demon pogibaet, on vozrozhdaetsja kak (2/25) demon otstupnik.

name: Greater Demon
sourceDescription: Pri vhode v igru nanosit uron protivniku i vsem ego sushhestvam ravnyj Sile Ognja hozjaina, no ne bolee 10.

name: Healing Spray
sourceDescription: Lechit 9 zhizni vybrannomu sushhestvu i 6 zhizni sushhestvam v sosednih slotah.

name: Fireball
sourceDescription: Nanosit 9 urona vybrannomu sushhestvu i 6 urona sushhestvam v sosednih slotah.

name: Steal Essence
sourceDescription: Nanosit 5 urona vybrannomu sushhestvu. Esli ono pogibaet ot jetogo urona, to sila char sygravshego jeto zaklinanie maga povyshaetsja na 4.

name: Sacrifice
sourceDescription: Unichtozhaet vybrannoe sushhestvo hozjaina. Povyshaet na 3 ego Sily Ognja, Vody, Vozduha i Zemli.

name: Ritual of Glory
sourceDescription: Polnost'ju isceljaet vseh sushhestv hozjaina, i povyshaet ih ataku na 3 do konca hoda.

name: Mana Burn
sourceDescription: Nanosit sushhestvam protivnika uron, ravnyj ego samoj vysokoj sile. Jeta sila ponizhaetsja na 3.

name: Sonic Boom
sourceDescription: Nanosit 11 urona protivniku i vsem ego sushhestvam. Oglushaet sushhestv protivnika, vynuzhdaja ih propustit' ataku na sledujushhem hodu.

name: Disintegrate
sourceDescription: Unichtozhaet vybrannoe sushhestvo i nanosit 11 urona vsem ostal'nym sushhestvam protivnika.

name: Magic Hamster
sourceDescription: Kogda volshebnyj homjak prizvan, on lechit 10 zhizni sushhestvam v sosednih slotah. Sposobnost' (stoimost' 3) Lechit 18 zhizni vsem sushhestvam hozjaina.

name: Scorpion
sourceDescription: Kogda skorpion prizvan, on otravljaet sushhestvo v slote naprotiv, vynuzhdaja ego propustit' ataku na sledujushhem hodu.'+' Sposobnost' (stoimost' 2) Nanosit 14 urona vybrannomu sushhestvu.

name: Wolverine
sourceDescription: Sposobnost' (stoimost' 2) Rosomaha polnost'ju isceljaetsja i ejo ataka povyshaetsja na 2 navsegda.

name: Energy Beast
sourceDescription: Sposobnost' (stoimost' 1) Povyshaet hozjainu na 1 sily Ognja, Vody, Vozduha i Zemli.

name: Death Falcon
sourceDescription: Sposobnost' (stoimost' 1) Smertonosnyj jastreb peremeshhaetsja v vybrannyj slot i nanosit 4 urona vsem sushhestvam protivnika.

name: White Elephant
sourceDescription: Ves' uron, nanesjonnyj po hozjainu, perenapravljaetsja v belogo slona. Sposobnost' (stoimost' 0) Belyj slon povyshaet hozjainu silu Prirody na 1.

name: Basilisk
sourceDescription: V konce kazhdogo hoda vasilisk nanosit 4 urona sushhestvam protivnika, imejushhim 8 libo men'she zhizni. Sposobnost' (stoimost' 0) Nanosit 6 urona vybrannomu sushhestvu.

name: Ancient Dragon
sourceDescription: Kogda Drevnij drakon prizvan, on povyshaet vse sily hozjaina na 1. Sposobnost' (stoimost' 3) Nanosit 10 urona protivniku i vsem ego sushhestvam.

name: Natural Healing
sourceDescription: Lechit 18 zhizni vsem sushhestvam hozjaina.

name: Poison
sourceDescription: Nanosit 14 urona vybrannomu sushhestvu.

name: Enrage
sourceDescription: Rosomaha polnost'ju isceljaetsja i ejo ataka povyshaetsja na 2 navsegda.

name: Pump Energy
sourceDescription: Povyshaet hozjainu na 1 sily Ognja, Vody, Vozduha i Zemli.

name: Move Falcon
sourceDescription: Smertonosnyj jastreb peremeshhaetsja v vybrannyj slot i nanosit 4 urona vsem sushhestvam protivnika.

name: Trumpet
sourceDescription: Belyj slon povyshaet hozjainu silu Prirody na 1.

name: Gaze
sourceDescription: Nanosit 6 urona vybrannomu sushhestvu.

name: Breathe Fire
sourceDescription: Nanosit 10 urona protivniku i vsem ego sushhestvam.

name: Rage of Souls
sourceDescription: Nanosit (9+sila Smerti) urona po sushhestvam protivnika. Igrok, sygravshij jeto zaklinanie, poluchaet 2 zhizni za kazhdoe pogibshee sushhestvo.

name: Jade Statue
sourceDescription: When Jade Statue is destroyed it deals 25 damages to each creature

name: Nettling Faerie
sourceDescription: At the end of owner's turn, Nettling Faerie moves to a random empty slot of owner's.

name: Merfolk Revolutionary
sourceDescription: Merfolk Revolutionary increases the growth of owner's water power by 1 and reduces the growth of opponent's water power by 1. Merfolk Revolutionary moves to the player with lower life.

name: Everraining Land
sourceDescription: Everraining land is immune to spells.Everraining Land increases the cost of all cards by 2 for both players. Each time any player skips a turn Everraining Land deals 5 damage to him.

name: Ambrosia Stone
sourceDescription: When Ambrosia Stone is destroyed opponent receives 20 life.

name: Phoenix Hydra
sourceDescription: Phoenix Hydra's attack damages opponent and each of opponent creatures. Each time Phoenix Hydra dies it reborns and its attack permanently increases by 1.

name: Baffler Roost
sourceDescription: Baffler Roost is immune to spells. Baffler Roost doubles the cost of all cards for both players.

name: Air Spirit
sourceDescription: Each Air Spirit's attack damages opponent and each of opponent's creature. Attack is equal to number of opponent's summoned creature.

name: Marching Stone
sourceDescription: Marching Stone is immune to spells. At the beginning of its owner's turn, Marching Stone moves one slot to the right,swapping positions with any creature in that slot.

name: Peace Tree
sourceDescription: Peace Tree reduces attack of opponent's creature by 1.

name: Niggling Imp
sourceDescription: At the beginning of its owner's turn, Niggling Imp moves to a random owner's slot while Niggling Imp remains in play owner can't use Demonic Card.

name: Mana Storm
sourceDescription: Each time owner uses a card of his speciality power type,his elemental powers are redistributed randomly.

name: Beehive
sourceDescription: At the beginning of its owner's turn, Beehive stuns the opponent's creature with the highest life.

name: SolidEcho
sourceDescription: Solid Echo dies after its first attack.

name: Demon Apostate
sourceDescription: Kazhdyj hod demon otstupnik lechit 2 zhizni hozjainu i vsem ego sushhestvam.

name: Rescue Operation
sourceDescription: Peremeshhaet vybrannoe sushhestvo v pustoj sluchajnyj slot, i esli jeto bylo svojo sushhestvo, to ono isceljaetsja na 5 zhizni.

name: Goblin Hero
sourceDescription: Goblin hrabrec poluchaet +2 k atake za kazhdoe sosednee sushhestvo. Kazhdyj raz, kogda protivnik prizyvaet sushhestvo v slot naprotiv, goblin hrabrec otstupaet v sluchajnyj pustoj slot.

name: Goblin Saboteur
sourceDescription: Kazhdyj raz, kogda goblin sabotazhnik nanosit uron po protivniku, tot terjaet verhnjuju kartu sluchajnoj stihii.

name: Army of Rats
sourceDescription: Nanosit 12 urona vsem sushhestvam protivnika. Zatem nanosit 12 urona sluchajnomu sushhestvu zaklinatelja.

name: Portal Jumper
sourceDescription: V konce kazhdogo hoda hozjaina master portalov oglushaet na hod sushhestvo naprotiv i peremeshhaetsja v sluchajnyj slot.

name: Goblin Looter
sourceDescription: Kazhdyj raz, kogda pogibaet sushhestvo, goblin marodjor povyshaet na 1 sluchajnuju Silu hozjaina.

name: Goblin Raider
sourceDescription: Kogda goblin rejder prizvan, dva drugih goblina rejdera pojavljajutsja v sluchajnyh slotah.

name: Ratsmaster
sourceDescription: Kazhdyj hod goblin krysovod nanosit 6 urona kazhdomu sushhestvu protivnika i ponizhaet na 3 sluchajnuju Silu hozjaina.

name: Crazy Squirrel
sourceDescription: Kogda bezumnaja belka prizvana, ona nanosit 8 urona sushhestvu v slote naprotiv.

name: Forest Wolf
sourceDescription: Lesnoj volk trebuet nalichija volshebnogo krolika v igre dlja prizyva. Lesnoj volk pojavljaetsja v slote krolika i s#edaet ego. Ataka volka ravna atake s#edennogo krolika.

name: Vindictive Raccoon
sourceDescription: Kogda mstitel'nyj enot prizvan, on nanosit protivniku uron ravnyj atake sushhestva v slote naprotiv.

name: Enraged Beaver
sourceDescription: Kogda raz#jarjonnyj bobjor prizvan, on nanosit uron po protivniku i ego sushhestvam ravnyj atake volshebnogo krolika, esli tot v igre.

name: Ritual of the Forest
sourceDescription: Lechit 5+X zhizni zaklinatelju i ego sushhestvam, gde X ravno atake volshebnogo krolika.

name: Treefolk Protector
sourceDescription: Trifolk zashhitnik ponizhaet na 3 ves' uron, nanesjonnyj zaklinanijami protivnika.

name: Bee Queen
sourceDescription: Kogda koroleva pchjol prizvana, ona prizyvaet 2/8 pchjol soldat v sosednie sloty. Kogda koroleva pchjol ili pchela soldat pogibaet, protivnik poluchaet 3 urona.

name: Angry Angry Bear
sourceDescription: Kazhdyj raz, kogda zlobnyj medved' poluchaet uron, ego ataka povyshaetsja na 1 navsegda.

name: Chrono Hunter
sourceDescription: Kazhdyj raz, kogda hronovoin ubivaet vrazheskoe sushhestvo, on povyshaet na 2 Silu vremeni hozjaina.

name: Timeblazer
sourceDescription: Kogda hronorycar' prizvan, sosednie sushhestva atakujut protivnika vmesto sushhestv naprotiv na jetom hodu.

name: Hasten
sourceDescription: Vybrannoe sushhestvo zaklinatelja nemedlenno atakuet protivnika i ego sushhestv. Jetim zaklinaniem mozhno uskorjat' lish' sushhestv s atakoj 9 libo nizhe.

name: TimeStop
sourceDescription: Nanosit 4 urona kazhdomu vrazheskomu sushhestvu i vynuzhdaet protivnika propustit' sledujushhij hod.

name: Timeweaver
sourceDescription: Kogda tkach vremeni prizvan, hozjain mozhet sygrat' dopolnitel'noe zaklinanie na jetom hodu. Tkach vremeni snizhaet stoimost' vseh zaklinanij hozjaina na 1.

name: Priestess of Moments
sourceDescription: Zhrica vremeni atakuet dva raza za hod. Pozvoljaet sushhestvam hozjaina atakovat' srazu zhe posle prizyva.

name: ChronoEngine
sourceDescription: Mashina vremeni pozvoljaet hozjainu igrat' dopolnitel'nuju kartu kazhdyj hod. Kazhdyj raz, kogda hozjain propuskaet hod, ego Sila vremeni povyshaetsja na 1.

name: Time Dragon
sourceDescription: Kogda vremennoj drakon prizvan, hozjain mozhet sygrat' eshhjo odnu kartu na jetom hodu. Vremennoj drakon atakuet na tom zhe hodu, kogda prizvan v igru.

name: Magic Rabbit
sourceDescription: Kazhdyj hod otshel'nik prizyvaet v igru volshebnogo krolika (passivnaja sposobnost' klassa). V igre mozhet byt' tol'ko odin volshebnyj krolik. Kazhdyj hod ataka volshebnogo krolika povyshaetsja na 1.

name: Bee Soldier
sourceDescription: Kogda pchela soldat pogibaet protivnik poluchaet 3 urona.

name: Vampiric Cloud
sourceDescription: Each time Vampiric Cloud attacks Its attack increases by 1 and its life by 2 permanently.

name: Living Tornado
sourceDescription: Living Tornado deals 2 damage to both player and all creatures each turn.

name: Hellbot
sourceDescription: At the beginning of its owner's turn, Hellbot reduces a random power of opponent by 2, or increases random power of opponent by 2

name: Fetid Swamp
sourceDescription: Fetid Swamp is immune to spells. Fetid Swamp deals 2 damage to each creature each turn.

name: Cloistered Elemental
sourceDescription: When any of owner's power become 12 or higher, Cloistered Elemental is released and becomes Supreme Elemental.

name: Supreme Elemental
sourceDescription: Attack is equal to highest owner power  Life 75

name: Volcanos
sourceDescription: Volcano is immune to spells. Volcano deals 5 damage to neighboring creatures each turn.

name: Astral Drake
sourceDescription: Astral drake's attack is owner's lowest power.Each turn Astral Drake regenerates 4 life to itself. Astral Drake's attack damages opponent and each of opponent's creatures.

name: Wandering Stone
sourceDescription: Wandering Stone is immune to spells. Wandering stone moves to a random slot each turn, swapping positions with any creature in that slot.

name: Temple of Fire
sourceDescription: Temple of Fire summons Priest of Fire each turn into a random empty slot.

name: Great Oak
sourceDescription: Great Oak summons Forest Sprite each turn into a random empty slot.

name: Academy of magic
sourceDescription: Academy of Magic is immune to spells. Each time owner casts a spell  Academy of Magic summons an Adept of Magic(4/12 creature) to a random empty slot.

name: Crusader
sourceDescription: Kogda Krestonosec prizvan, on isceljaet 2 zhizni vsem sushhestvam hozjaina.

name: Holy Avenger
sourceDescription: Kazhdyj raz, kogda sosednee sushhestvo pogibaet, ataka Svjashhennogo mstitelja povyshaetsja na 2 navsegda.

name: Templar
sourceDescription: Kazhdyj raz, kogda hozjain Hramovnika prizyvaet sushhestvo v slot rjadom s nim, Hramovnik nanosit 4 urona protivniku.

name: Divine Justice
sourceDescription: Isceljaet 12 urona vybrannomu sushhestvu, nanosit 12 urona vsem ostal'nym sushhestvam.

name: Divine Meddling
sourceDescription: Povyshaet na 2 Sily Ognja, Vody, Vozduha i Zemli magu, sygravshemu jeto zaklinanie. Nanosit 10 urona protivniku.

name: Rage of God
sourceDescription: Nanosit 12 urona sushhestvam protivnika i zatem nanosit protivniku 3 urona za kazhdoe ucelevshee sushhestvo protivnika.

name: Angel
sourceDescription: Pri vhode v igru povyshaet Silu Svjatosti hozjaina na 3.

name: Angel of War
sourceDescription: Kogda Angel vojny prizvan, on nanosit 8 urona sushhestvam protivnika i lechit 8 zhizni sushhestvam hozjaina.

name: Blood Boil
sourceDescription: Nanosit 4 urona vrazheskim sushhestvam. Mag poluchaet 1 silu Krovi za kazhdoe sushhestvo, ubitoe jetim zaklinaniem.

name: Ghoul
sourceDescription: Kazhdyj raz, kogda vrazheskoe sushhestvo pogibaet, ataka upyrja povyshaetsja na 1 navsegda.

name: Devoted Servant
sourceDescription: '+'Kazhdyj hod ataka predannogo slugi rastjot na 1. Kogda on pogibaet, sila Krovi ego hozjaina povyshaetsja na znachenie ataki predannogo slugi.

name: Vampire Mystic
sourceDescription: Kazhdyj raz, kogda protivnik poluchaet uron, ataka vampira mistika povyshaetsja na 2 do konca tekushhego hoda.

name: Justicar
sourceDescription: Protivopolozhnoe sushhestvo poluchaet udvoennyj uron ot zaklinanij i sushhestv. Esli slot naprotiv vershitelja pust, to ves' uron nanesjonnyj protivniku povyshaetsja na 2.

name: Chastiser
sourceDescription: Ataka karatelja povyshaetsja na 2 kazhdyj raz, kogda hozjain poluchaet uron. Jeto usilenie propadaet posle ataki karatelja.

name: Vampire Elder
sourceDescription: Kogda vampir starejshina prizvan, on razmeshhaet v sosednie sloty molodyh vampirov (5/14). Poka vampir starejshina zhiv, on predotvrashhaet ves' uron, nanesjonnyj po molodym vampiram.

name: Magister of Blood
sourceDescription: Kogda magistr krovi prizvan, on nanosit 16 urona protivniku i vsem ego zablokirovannym sushhestvam.

name: Fanatic
sourceDescription: Fanatik poluchaet udvoennyj uron ot zaklinanij protivnika.

name: Call to Ancient Spirits
sourceDescription: Nanosit 10 urona sushhestvam protivnika i 5 urona svoim sushhestvam.

name: Zealot
sourceDescription: Kazhdyj hod ataka bezumca povyshaetsja na 2. Kogda bezumec nanosit uron, on terjaet takoe zhe kolichestvo zhizni.

name: Monument to Rage
sourceDescription: Sushhestva vladel'ca atakujut 2 raza za hod. Kogda sushhestvo vladel'ca nanosit uron atakoj, monument jarosti terjaet stol'ko zhe zhizni.

name: Cursed Unicorn
sourceDescription: Poka prokljatyj edinorog zablokirovan, on terjaet 5 zhizni kazhdyj hod. No pri jetom ves' uron, poluchennyj im ot zaklinanij, perenapravljaetsja v sushhestvo v slote naprotiv.

name: Blind Prophet
sourceDescription: Povyshaet rost sil Ognja, Vody, Vozduha i Zemli hozjaina na 1. Ponizhaet rost sily Kul'ta hozjaina na 1.

name: Reaver
sourceDescription: Ves' uron, nanesjonnyj sushhestvam hozjaina, perenapravljaetsja v Rivera. Poka on zhiv, hozjain ne mozhet ispol'zovat' zaklinanija.

name: Greater Bargul
sourceDescription: Kogda verhovnyj bargul prizvan, on nanosit 20 urona vsem drugim sushhestvam. Nanosit 3 urona hozjainu kazhdyj hod.

name: Golem Frenzy
sourceDescription: Nanosit 3 urona sushhestvam protivnika. Za kazhdoe sushhestvo, pogibshee ot jetogo jeffekta, ataka golema povyshaetsja na 3 do konca hoda.

name: Guardian Statue
sourceDescription: Storozhevaja statuja imunna ko vsemu uronu, poka ne shodit v pervuju ataku.

name: Golem's Justice
sourceDescription: Nanosit 4 urona vsem sushhestvam protivnika. Lechit 4 zhizni sosedjam golema.

name: Army Upgrade
sourceDescription: Lechit 3 zhizni sushhestvam maga. Navsegda povyshaet ataku golema na 2. (jeto usilenie sohranjaetsja posle smerti golema).

name: Golem Instructer
sourceDescription: Instruktor golema povyshaet ataku golema na 2.

name: Dark Sculptor
sourceDescription: Kogda tjomnyj skul'ptor prizvan, on nanosit sushhestvam protivnika uron, ravnyj kolichestvu sushhestv v igre.

name: Golem Guide
sourceDescription: Kogda provodnik golema prizvan, on menjaetsja mestami s golemom i povyshaet ataku golema na 3 do konca hoda.

name: Golem Handler
sourceDescription: Poka operator golema v igre, golem delaet dopolnitel'nuju ataku kazhdyj hod.

name: Golem
sourceDescription: Golem ne poluchaet urona ot zaklinanij i sposobnostej sushhestv. Kogda golem pogibaet, on prizyvaetsja snova v sluchajnyj slot, i ego hozjain terjaet 10 zhizni.

name: Initiate
sourceDescription: Poka vampir starejshina zhiv, on predotvrashhaet ves' uron po molodym vampiram.

name: Powderkeg
sourceDescription: When destroyed does 2 damage to neighboring creature slots: left, right, across and diagonal across. There is a 25% chance they destroy themselves each turn.
